name: How long does a typical kitchen remodel take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen remodel take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen remodel typically takes between 6 and 12 weeks of active construction, though complex custom projects can take longer. The overall timeline depends heavily on the project scope, such as whether walls are coming down or plumbing is moving. Lead times for custom cabinetry and special-order countertops often require an additional 4 to 8 weeks before demolition begins. To avoid unnecessary downtime, physical work usually begins only after major fixtures, cabinets, and appliances have arrived or have confirmed delivery dates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen remodels take 6 to 12 weeks of construction. Cabinet lead times and material deliveries often add 4 to 8 weeks of planning before demo starts.
